name: Plant Nerd | Bubble Bath
description: We’re big fans of Soap and wanted to see how Project 4516 mixed with it. Bubble Bath takes on a lot of the better qualities of Soap and adds a freshness, not dissimilar from fresh laundry, from Project 4516. It has a unique flavor, dense green bud structure, and a balanced clear high. It’s just all around good bud.
